D\. Devagnanavaram, K\. Chitrarasu, Jonathan Kew, David Marshall, D\. Prabhakar, Cal Rensch, and James Stahl\.
A sociolinguistic survey of koya dialects\.
Technical Report 2021\-029, SIL International, 2021\.
Survey fieldwork 1985–1986\. Seven lects retain canonical Gondi and their registered locality tags\. Narrative spelling is preserved without invented phonemic interpretation; section3\.1\.4 G maps to voiced velar fricative following its explicit definition\. Wordlists preserve literal single\-dot versus colon length, raised vowels and consonant marks in a separate source\-notation profile; Phonemic remains blank\. Unresolved handwritten glyphs and question\-shaped signs retain explicit interpretation uncertainty\. Source free translations remain paired at printed segment boundaries, without inferred word alignment\. Expected comprehension answers are audit evidence rather than lexical gloss content\. Explicitly named but undefined terms retain blank glosses and context\. No cognate edges inferred from sound comparisons\. Wordlist uncertainty remains in Notes, audit and tags; no new coordinates inferred\.
URL: [https://www\.sil\.org/resources/archives/88873](https://www.sil.org/resources/archives/88873)\.
scope: Only small source registry, language/dialect registry and in-memory Bib formatting; no shared metadata or compiled outputs changed.
